description: What the measured episodes suggest about what to make next. Explicitly separate from performance_window: that is the observation, this is the opinion, and keeping them apart means a bad conclusion can be revised without re-measuring and a good one can be traced to the numbers it came from.

sample_size.description: Episodes the guidance is based on. Carried alongside the advice so a reader can weigh it.

confidence_note.description: What this sample can and cannot support. With a handful of videos the honest answer is 'not much yet', and saying so is the point.

evidence.description: The specific episodes and numbers behind it. Guidance without evidence is a hunch wearing a suit.
